spec.name: Oak Dish Round Wall Sconce with Opal Globe
spec.silhouette: Circular concave dish with a central protruding sphere
spec.proportions: 22 cm diameter backplate, 12 cm total depth, with globe occupying approximately half of the backplate diameter
details: Shallow turned oak backplate serving as a natural reflector
Centrally positioned glowing opal glass orb
spec.studio_prompt: A modern circular wall sconce measuring 22 cm in diameter and 12 cm in depth, featuring a shallow concave dish backplate turned from solid natural oak (#98764a, #9b8361) displaying smooth, subtle wood grain with warm shadow accents (#8c643a). Protruding from the exact center is a spherical frosted opal glass diffuser globe in soft luminous off-white (#cec1b1). The illuminated glass sphere casts a soft, warm radial glow across the curved interior wood surface with flush, seamless construction and no visible hardware.
